dedupe_keys.name: critical minerals advanced projects mines and processing facilities in canada

description: This Natural Resources Canada dataset maps primary processing facilities such as smelters and refineries, mines and advanced projects related to Canada's 34 critical minerals. Advanced projects are those with measured or indicated reserves or resources whose viability is supported by a preliminary economic assessment or a prefeasibility or feasibility study, and each site processes, produces or considers producing at least one critical mineral. Mines and processing facilities come from Map 900A; advanced project data are compiled from public sources and published every year with the provinces and territories. Coverage is national, and the 2025 edition was updated on 27 February 2026. Access is free under the Open Government Licence - Canada as a bilingual file geodatabase, ArcMap project files, ESRI REST and OGC WMS services and an Atlas of Canada web map. Caveats: NRCan does not assume responsibility for errors or omissions and asks users to report revisions, and some linked pages are external. For simulation it supports supply-risk, dependency and resilience analyses of critical mineral supply chains and the exposure of mines and processing plants. Related catalogue records include Map 900A, the EU Raw Materials Information System and the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries.
